title: Keyboard backlight Fn+F7 and display brightness via ACPI _Qxx methods
summary: Investigation documents that SSDT-EC.aml does not expose _Q14/_Q15 (_QD7/_QD8) brightness events, AsusSMC 1.4.1 may be incompatible with Tahoe 26.7.1, and SSDT-KBBacklight.aml is a minimal stub. No EFI changes made yet.
